notes.title: Who's Who 2.0 Release Announcement
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41616265/74072a5feb3c34578413bef4e6d1e1fba1a322fd.png

Dear real players
We have great news regarding Who’s Who.
The 2nd version, Who’s Who 2.0 have finally launched on Steam. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3391260/WHOS_WHO_20/


Search Who’s Who 2.0 on steam if you are interested. 
We sincerely apologize we couldn’t continue developing the game on our own,
But former development of the Who’s Who team have formed a new company,
Continued developing the game on the name of Nightvendors Studio.
They have prepared this project for quite a while. 

Most of the aspects that we wanted Who’s Who to have, have been added in the new version.
New skills for characters and new maps have been added.
The psychological aspect of the game stays, but the battle has changed dynamically. 

Wish all the users who have enjoyed our Who’s Who
Could continue playing it on the new version Who’s Who 2.0
We will join you guys as players in the new version.
We will see you guys all in the new game~

notes.title: Major Update Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Hello Non-NPCs!

We want to thank all who joined the first “Who’s Who?” Halloween event! We really hope that it was as enjoyable for you as it was for us. We also want to congratulate everyone who unlocked the time-limited Halloween character skins, and hope you enjoy showing off your exclusive skins in future games! While we are now wrapping up the Halloween event, Who’s Who’s new game mode, Thirst for Blood, will continue to be available for all to play!

The Next “Who’s Who?” Update:

With the Halloween season over, we have a new update with new features!

Convenience updates:

 Thanks to all our non-NPCs’ feedback we have been working on adding a Room List section in game so that it is much easier for non-NPCs to find and join rooms with more players in them!
 We will also be adding the Winner Display screen after each match to announce the winner of the round!

Additionally, the update will have:

a new character skin
a new game mode!

These changes will be implemented during the month of November, which we hope will make the game more enjoyable and convenient for you! Once again, we want to thank all our non-NPCs for supporting the game and wish you a great November! 

That is all for now non-NPCs! If you wish to join our community on discord or check out our social media:

Discord
Twitter 
Instagram
Facebook
Website

- G1 Playgrounds Development Team

notes.title: Who's Who? Halloween Update!
notes.notes:
🎃Enjoy Your 2022 Halloween in Who's Who!🎃

Dear Non-NPCs,

We are back with a brand new update to celebrate the Halloween season! We have added a new mode that fits perfectly with the spooky atmosphere of Halloween, along with two new character skins that you don't want to miss!

Updates and Bug Fixes:

 Loading bug - you can now see the status of other players’ connection while loading
 Fixed an issue where only private rooms were being created
 Fixed a bug where the room host could walk through other players
 Fixed an issue where players could not select a game mode while in the tutorial
 Changed the location of jewels in Police and Thief mode to better balance the mode between different maps

💣Bombs Away Mode Changes💣

Remember how you would desperately try to find a person to pass the bomb too, only to have it blow up on you because your fellow non-NPCs are too good at acting? 

Those days are gone! We have added new a rule, and some modifications, to Bombs Away which will help players to find other players more easily.These changes should help make the mode more balanced, and more fun, whether you have the bomb or not!

Changes:

 Previously, passing the bomb added 8 seconds to the bomb’s timer. It has been adjusted to add fewere seconds which makes the bomb tick faster.
 To prevent players from standing still the whole time, we’ve added a bird that will circle a player’s head if they stand still for too long.
 Once the player begins moving again, the bird will leave, meaning you have to be strategic in where, and for how long, you stand in one place.

🧛Thirst For Blood Mode🧛

We have decorated some of our current maps to match the creepy Halloween atmosphere. However, beware of the vampires that lurk in the night!

Details:

 Play as a vampire
 Every 3 seconds, you will lose some blood. Once you run out, you’ll faint.
 Find, and kick, other vampires to get more blood, or use the blood vessel item to fill your meter.
 Don’t worry! If you get hit, vampire magic will teleport you to safety.

🎃New Character Skins🎃 

We’ve added two new character skins to the game! These skins can only be obtained during the Halloween seasonal event (00:00AM UTC November 8th). The skins can be obtained by completing the required achievements. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41616265/25546e78f1f2830021e500811d40d3efa1432687.png

Vampire skin:

 She’s a cute and pretty Vampire wearing a Gothic dress
 She has ruby-red eyes, wings, and a pale skin tone that makes her truly a creature of the night!

Reaper skin:

 The reaper decided to be a bit more hip and stylish!
 He is wearing a unique reaper mask with his signature sickle on his back. 

This Halloween update will bring fun new content for you all to enjoy! If you have any questions regarding the update, please feel free to let us know in discord or in the discussion threads. Along with it, We would like to thank all the streamers and content creators for making videos of our game.Our crew members enjoy watching the videos and laughing our hearts out at all the crazy antics! We will be coming back soon with more game content and convenience updates, so please stay posted!

🕸️Have a creepy Who's Who Day🕸️

notes.title: Halloween Event Update!
notes.notes:
Hello there Non-NPCs

We have came back with a Halloween update.
We gladly present our new mode in the game along with two new in-game earned skins. 

1. New game modes - Thirst for Blood
- Thirst for Blood is the new mode in the game where you become a vampire and be the last vampire standing. obtain blood by using items or draining it out from other vampires by attacking them.

2. New Skins
We have created two additional skins that is totally different from our previous skins. 

Vampire - can be obtained by playing Thirst for Blood mode.

Reaper - can be obtained by playing all other modes.

These skins are seasonal skin that will be allowed to unlock only during the Halloween period. So hurry up and start unlocking the Skins.

notes.title: Post-Release Updates, Bug Fixes, and Road Map
notes.notes:
Hello Non-NPCs! 

Thank you so much for all the love and support for "Who's Who?" during the few weeks since we've released the game. We know many of you have been curious about our plans for the game, so we would like to share some insights regarding new features and content coming in future updates. 
Bug fixes
We apologize to all of the players who have suffered from in-game bugs. We currently have a list of most of the issues, and will be releasing small updates as we fix them. Here are the first batch of fixes that we have planned:

Planned Bug Fixes:

 Loading screen bug
 Teleport bug
 Hawk-eye item bug
 Bug where Characters would get stuck in the wall 

Convenience updates
Many of our players have requested a communication function while in the lobby. So we are planning to add a feature allowing players to communicate with each other in the lobby with Emojis. We are also planning to add a result page to congratulate the players who have won in each round. Finally, we are going to add the ability to select random game modes within a lobby.

Updates:

 Emoji to be added in lobby
 Round result page to be added
 Random game mode to be added

Content Roadmap
Good news, non-NPC's! We are also sharing some of our plans for additional post-release content below. First, we will add 2 new game modes, to be announced at a future date. Furthermore, to celebrate the Halloween season, we are planning to add some Halloween-themed skins to the game for your enjoyment!

We are also evaluating was to adjust the mechanics of the Bombs Away mode to make it even more enjoyable to play. We have also heard about the balance issue in Police and Thief mode, and will adjust the balance of the game as well. While we can't currently give an exact date for the new content and gameplay adjustments, we are working hard to bring these exciting updates to the game as soon as possible!

Finally, we are pleased to announce that we are planning to port "Who's Who?" to the Switch, Xbox, and PlayStation 5 sometime around the end of the year! 

Roadmap Highlights:

 Adding two new modes
 Adding Halloween-themed skins
 Bombs Away Mode : Game mechanics adjustment
 Police and Thief mode : game balancing

We appreciate all the non-NPCs who have given their feedback to us to help make the game even better post-release. Stay tuned here, and on our Discord, for more news regarding future "Who's Who?" updates! 

Thank you,
The G1Playground Team

Follow, like, or join us on:
Facebook
Twitter
Instagram
Discord

notes.title: Update v0.9.17: HOT FIX
notes.notes:
Dear Everyone!

We appreciate all the loves you have sent towards . 
After launching the game yesterday, we have seen many bugs occur in the game. 
We truly apologize for the build not being so stable. 

We knew that an immediate patch was required and had prepared a new build. 
We have fixed critical issues occurring in the game, and further patches will be lined up to stabilize the game.

[Main Fixes]
- Characters getting stuck in the wall
- Going in to a game lobby where the game has started already
- Characters moving around in the lobby
- The error character showing up in the next mode
- Ghost showing up in the irrelevant map
- Able to revive outside of the red-zone

If you have any questions regarding the game, 
please use the discussion below to let us know. 
We apologize once again for the inconvenience and we will give our best to make something better. 
Thank you.

G1Playground
